purpose: SlicerMLArray lets 3D Slicer open and save MLArray (.mla) files through File > Add Data and File > Save. Images become volumes, label maps become named segmentations, and bounding boxes become Markups ROIs. A module panel exports ROIs as box-only .mla files.
summary: I read the whole Python source, CMake files and catalog entry. I found no malicious behaviour, network access, telemetry, or unsafe deserialization (only json.loads of node attributes and metadata). The only environment change is a user-confirmed, on-demand `pip_install("mlarray>=1.0.0,<2")`, triggered at the first load or save and not at import. CMake installs every imported Python file, EXTENSION_DEPENDS "NA" matches the empty build_dependencies, and the license is MIT. The remaining points are minor: `scm_revision` is the moving branch "main"; the transitive dependencies of mlarray could not be checked; a crafted label table can force a huge allocation; and the self-test may open the install prompt. 🟢 Recommend merge.
